mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_outbox ( event_id, channel, topic, message_key, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{channel}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, 'NEW', NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('NEW', 'FAILED')

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = NOW(), last_error = 'reset stale SENDING record', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND updated_at <= #{threshold}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM event_outbox GROUP BY status
SELECT channel, status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM event_outbox GROUP BY channel, status
SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'FAILED', 'SENDING')
SELECT channel, MIN(created_at) AS oldest_created_at FROM event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'FAILED', 'SENDING') GROUP BY channel
